newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish unemployment down to 11.7 pct in May -Belka.
newsitem.headline: Polish unemployment down to 11.7 pct in May -Belka.

text.p: Poland's unemployment rate fell to 11.7 percent in May from April's 12.4 percent, putting the May figure below the government's target for year-end, the finance minister said on Tuesday.

"The unemployment rate for the end of May is 11.7 percent and so it's already lower than that which we forecast for the end of the year," Marek Belka said after a cabinet meeting, referring to the government's 11.9 percent year-end forecast.
Economy Minister Wieslaw Kaczmarek told the conference that the governmnent expected the unemployment rate to fall to 11 percent next year.
